name: Fresh Coconut Water
desc: Water from a green coconut, straight from the palm. Palms are everywhere in the Chagos, and coconut was once the whole economy of the islands. Restores 170 HP.

name: Fish Curry and Rice
desc: Fish, coconut and rice are the old staples of the Chagos islands, and a fish curry with a lot of rice is still the dish people remember. Restores 280 HP.

name: Navy Brew
desc: Strong tea in a tin mug, made by someone who has been awake for most of the night. It is not subtle and it is not meant to be. Restores 140 HP.

name: Whitewash and Brushes
one: a tin of Whitewash and Brushes
desc: A tin of whitewash, a bundle of brushes and a pair of gloves, borrowed from the Navy stores for a day's work at East Point. Be gentle with it.

name: Miniature Ravanne
desc: A tiny goatskin drum on a cord, the sort you'd tap three times for luck. The ravanne carries the beat of sega, the music of the Chagossians, which is still played and sung wherever the community lives.
